title: Natural residue homology comparison with evaluation scalars
statement: Let W,U,w be an affine open neighborhood of w and let p=ker(evaluation at w). For every localized module complex K there is an additive isomorphism from affineResidueCycleHomology to homology of its section complex extended along evaluation to kappa(w). The family intertwines every chain map. This transports new-affine-residue-quotient-homology-naturality using the canonical chart residue-field isomorphism of lem-sc-affine-residue-scalar-transport.

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Use the affine chart kernel formula to identify p with its chart prime. Form the canonical isomorphism kappa(w) -> kappa(p) from the open immersion and affine chart residue maps. The natural scalar transport isomorphism identifies extension to kappa(p) followed by restriction with extension along evaluation.

Restriction along the field isomorphism is exact. Commute it with complex homology using mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality. Compose the resulting natural comparison with the quotient comparison and evaluate naturality on each class.

lean.statement: theorem affine_residue_evaluation_homology_naturality (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom) : let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive) let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ∃ e : ∀ K, affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ (G.obj K).homology 1, ∀ K C (φ : K ⟶ C) z, e C (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map φ) 1 (e K z)
